The rights one instance reported, in the shape the gate consumes

round_rights.Rd

The permission column is added only when the instance actually reported it. Inventing a column of NAs would reach scope_errors()'s closed failure by a different route and make the two cases indistinguishable upstream, where they have to be told apart.

Usage

round_rights(server, state)

Arguments

server

The instance name, which a state reply names once at the top and not on every row.

state

What module_state() returned.

Value

A data frame with server, project_id, username, and user_rights only when it was reported.
